optimizedDescription.value: Authoritative layered specd.yaml configuration for schemas, workspaces, storage, graph, context, approvals, and plugins.

optimizedContext.value:
# Project Configuration

## Rules
- One shared `specd.yaml` config drives CLI, MCP, plugins: schema, workspaces, storage, artifact constraints, graph, context, plugins.
- Discovery: explicit `--config` selects only that file+its `extends` chain. Otherwise walk upward from host root/CWD until first candidate directory or VCS root; never above VCS root. No VCS ancestor→CWD only.
- Candidate order: `specd.yaml`; `specd.*.yaml` alphabetical; `specd.local.yaml`; `specd.local.*.yaml` alphabetical. Bootstrap commands may run without config; `--config` meaning unchanged.
- Cascade: later layers override scalars, deep-merge objects, append arrays unless targeted removal. `extends` exactly `true` or one same-chain path. `remove` only with extends; structural identities: root fields, workspace/storage keys, `context[].id`, `plugins.agents[].name`. Required fields not removable.
- Local file without extends is independent root; `extends:true` inherits prior active layer. `specd init` gitignores local variants.
- Optional privacy mode `hash|mask|anonymous`; hash requires salt; actor exclusions default specd/system; metadata whitelist optional. Environment actor/privacy variables override files.
- Required `schema` selects one project schema. Prefix determines exact npm/workspace/local/path resolution; no fallback. Resolve immediately before command body except help/version/init/config-validate/plugin. Config and schema failures use distinct domain errors.
- Optional `schemaPlugins` apply after base extends chain in declaration order and require `kind: schema-plugin`; inline `schemaOverrides` apply last using validated create/remove/set/append/prepend operations.
- Optional `invalidationPolicy`: `none|surgical|downstream|global`.
- `workspaces` required and nonempty; `default` required/reserved local workspace; `root` forbidden/reserved for graph globals.
- Workspace fields: optional prefix; required specs adapter; optional schemas adapter; `codeRoot`; ownership `owned|shared|readOnly`; optional graph/context filters. Non-default `codeRoot` required; default uses project root.
- FS specs require path; optional `metadataPath` resolves absolute and wires repository. Absent metadata path derivation belongs to kernel composition, not loader.
- Default local schema store applies only to default workspace; qualified missing workspace schema errors.
- Project graph: optional includes for global resources and global exclusions. Included file uses `root:` only outside every workspace code root; global exclusions cannot be overridden.
- Workspace graph: `respectGitignore` default true; optional allowed paths; explicit exclusions replace built-ins. Gitignore exclusions have absolute priority.
- Storage bindings are named adapter+`config`; omitted sections default to FS paths under `specdPath`. Raw bindings plus absolute staging paths exposed. Unknown named adapter fails clearly.
- `specdPath` defaults `.specd`; derive absolute data/config/graph/tmp/storage/lock paths. Loader verifies all resolved directories and raises `StorageDirectoryNotFoundError`.
- Template tokens `{{namespace.key}}` expand at runtime; unmatched token remains and emits warning.
- Context spec patterns support exact, prefix `/*`, workspace-qualified, and whole-workspace `*` forms. Project unqualified defaults to `default`; workspace unqualified defaults to self. Invalid syntax errors; unknown workspace warns at startup/errors in validation.
- Active workspaces derive from change spec metadata. `CompileContext` resolves workspace through configured specs paths, never CWD/codeRoot/filesystem scan.
- Compile order: explicit context entries; project includes then excludes; active-workspace includes then excludes; transitive `dependsOn`. Dependencies bypass excludes. First match wins ordering/dedupe; explicit context entries remain independent.
- Context defaults: project include `default:*`; project exclude empty; workspace include `*`; workspace exclude empty.
- `contextMode`: `list|summary|full|hybrid`; default summary; project-only; removed `lazy` rejected.
- Context entries are instruction/file with optional stable ID; file relative to active config layer unless absolute.
- Approvals: independent `spec` and `signoff` gates default false; enabled gates require explicit approval/signoff states and audit identity/reason/time before implementation/archive.
- Optional logging level includes `trace|debug|info|warn|error|silent`; default info.
- `llmOptimizedContext` boolean defaults false; true opts into LLM-enriched spec metadata/context.
- Plugins shape `plugins.agents[] = { name, config? }`; strict load validation, unknown plugin types rejected.
- `ConfigWriter` supports init, add/remove/list plugin. Add is idempotent and writes typed plugin array.
- Loader rejects invalid cascade/removal/unknown fields through `ConfigValidationError`; legacy-compatible shapes emit preserved nonfatal `SpecdConfig.warnings`.

## Constraints
- Strict Zod validation at load; unknown top-level fields rejected.
- Hash privacy requires salt.
- Discovery never leaks config above VCS root.
- Cascade failures block startup; legacy warnings do not.
- One schema and one project-level context mode.
